facts.subject: MesoWest Weather Fusion Node
facts.text: Weather training shall explain how the MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supports situational awareness
Initial qualification shall include supervised console practice, scenario walkthroughs, and a documented check by an authorized instructor
Annual refresher training shall include changes to software screens, revised thresholds, updated contact rosters, seasonal hazard briefings, and lessons learned
Tabletop exercises shall be conducted before the expected peak fire period
Live exercises shall be scheduled at least once per season when conditions permit
Exercise controllers shall inject realistic complications

Performance measures shall include time from automated detection to human review, time from review to command notification, time to resource assignment, communication completion rate, and accuracy of incident status updates
Detection quality shall be evaluated using confirmed events, benign smoke sources, weather-related artifacts, and operator notes
Every false-alarm review shall identify the apparent cause, affected sensors or analytic outputs, operator actions, dispatch consequences, and any recommended tuning or training change
The review board shall include operations, aviation, field crew, maintenance, and county liaison representatives when the event affected more than one operational function

Seasonal readiness shall require each active user to demonstrate current proficiency, complete required safety briefings, and acknowledge the current operating procedures before receiving operational access

facts.subject: Airspace Restricted State
facts.text: Acceptance of the Airspace Restricted State workflow shall require evidence that operational users can recognize restrictions, apply required controls, and recover normal coordination when restrictions are lifted
Any waiver to acceptance criteria shall identify the operational impact, compensating procedure, expiration date, and accountable owner
After-action reviews shall be held after major incidents, readiness exercises, significant false alarms, missed detections, and coordination gaps
Each after-action review shall reconstruct the timeline from system logs, user accounts, communications records, and maintenance notes without assigning blame
Review facilitators shall document what was expected to happen, what actually happened, why differences occurred, and which corrective actions are necessary
Corrective actions shall be entered into a controlled improvement backlog with assigned ownership, target completion dates, verification methods, and linkage to the originating event
Data stewardship shall define retention, access control, quality review, and disposition rules
Operational data used for model evaluation shall be protected from unauthorized alteration and shall preserve enough context

the governance board shall compare system performance, operational workload, maintenance burden, and user feedback against the acceptance criteria
The resulting improvement plan shall define which procedures, training materials, interfaces, algorithms, and support arrangements will be revised
